SESSION 13 WHY AND HOW SHOULD I TELL OTHERS?  
 
“Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the 
Son and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you.” 
(Matthew 28:18–20) 
 
Why tell others? 
• Jesus told us to 
• For the needs of others – spiritual hunger in the world 
• It’s good news: “Gospel” = Good News 
• Two opposite dangers 
– Insensitivity 
– Fear 
 
How do we tell others? 
 
 
1. PRESENCE (Matthew 5:13–16) 
 
• We are called to be salt and light. (vv.13–14) 
• When people know we are Christians, they watch our lives. (v.16) 
 
“You are the salt of the earth… You are the light of the world… let your light shine before 
others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.” (Matthew 
5:13–16)
